svg.text: Cut 56 mm off the extrusion, square to its length, so the fins stand

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: upright. Face both cut ends flat; deburr; keep the ports clean.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The four corner ports are part of the extrusion; tap them M4 from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: both ends, 12 mm deep (they take the floor and lid screws).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Connector end wall (short wall, holes 28.5 above the bottom edge,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: measured from the socket side's outer face): XT90 slot 12 x 22 at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 28 with two 3.2 holes 14.5 above and below; motor 20.5 hole at 56;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: safety loop 16.5 hole at 83 and command 16.5 hole at 109, each with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: four 3.2 holes on a 15 mm square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Socket side: speed socket 8.5 hole between the 1st and 2nd fins from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the far end, 24.5 from that end, 18 above the bottom edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Far end wall: vent hole 5 mm on the centre line, 43 above the bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each socket seats flat; nothing fouls a port or a fin.
